subject: feat(quest-validator): add agentic (Claude Code / OAuth) end-to-end validation
body:
Adds a second validation tier on top of the structural validator. Where tier 1
(quest_validator.py) checks that a quest is *shaped* correctly, tier 2 drives
Claude Code — authenticated via OAuth — to actually read a quest, attempt its
commands end-to-end in an isolated sandbox, and judge whether the content,
commands, and details work. It returns a weighted 0-100 score plus prioritized,
actionable recommendations.

What's included
- test/quest-validator/agentic/ package:
  - schema.py   — 6 weighted dimensions (commands 30%, accuracy 25%, completeness
                  15%, clarity 15%, safety 10%, structure 5%); the overall score
                  is computed in Python from the model's per-dimension scores
                  (never trusting model arithmetic). JSON Schema for --json-schema.
  - prompts.py  — review (read-only) vs execute (sandboxed) system/user prompts.
  - loader.py   — quest discovery + frontmatter parsing; reuses quest_registry so
                  it can't disagree with tier 1 on what's a playable quest; a
                  deterministic, level-spread sampler.
  - runner.py   — builds + invokes `claude -p --output-format json --json-schema`
                  with mode-appropriate tool allow/deny lists, sandboxes each
                  quest in a temp dir (QUEST.md only — no repo access), parses
                  every structured-output envelope shape, and detects auth

author: Amr
subject: fix(ci): stop dependency-checker false-positive spam + retire its auto-update job (#377)
body:
* fix(ci): stop dependency-checker filing false-positive issue spam

The dependency checker filed a fresh '🚨 Critical: Dependency/Build Issues'
issue on every run (11 piled up), each claiming a security vulnerability with
empty details while every other check was green.

Three root causes fixed:
- False positive: 'bundle-audit check --format json 2>&1' corrupted the JSON
  and trusted the exit code, which is non-zero for benign findings (e.g.
  insecure sources). Now stderr is separated and the result is decided by
  parsing actual 'unpatched_gem' advisories with jq.
- No dedup: date-stamped titles + unconditional 'gh issue create'. Now it
  maintains ONE open issue, updated in place, and auto-closes it when the
  check goes green.
- Over-firing triggers: ran on every _config.yml / Dockerfile /
  .github/workflows/** push. Narrowed to Gemfile / Gemfile.lock + the weekly
  schedule.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* refactor(ci): retire dependency-checker auto-update job (Dependabot owns gem bumps)

Removes the scheduled 'bundle update' -> direct push of Gemfile.lock to main,
plus its now-orphaned force_update/security_only manual inputs and the cross-job
outdated_gems output. Dependabot's grouped + auto-merged bundler updates now
solely own gem bumps, so the two no longer compete to rewrite Gemfile.lock.
The workflow is now check-only (no direct push to main).

subject: fix(quests): repair Liquid raw nesting that broke the production Pages build (#387)
body:
* fix(quests): repair Liquid raw nesting that broke the production Pages build

The production GitHub Pages deploy (legacy gh-pages build, strict Liquid) failed
with "Liquid syntax error: Unknown tag 'endraw'" after #384 merged, taking the
live site down. Root cause: a NESTED {% raw %} block — rawwrap wrapped a code
block that already contained an inline {% raw %}…{% endraw %} guard
(`if: {% raw %}${{ always() }}{% endraw %}`). raw does not nest, so the inner
endraw closed the block early and the outer endraw was orphaned. The chapters'
"Jekyll escape" notes also printed the literal {% raw %} tag names, which Liquid
consumed as real tags.

Why CI missed it: the PR Jekyll build runs with _config_dev.yml's
`liquid.error_mode: warn`, which DOWNGRADES Liquid parse errors to warnings, so
`bundle exec jekyll build` exited 0. Production builds with _config.yml only
(strict), so the same error is fatal. The quest validator only counted raw/endraw
balance, not nesting/placement — all three layers missed it for the same reason.

Fix:
- Un-nest every raw block and neutralize the literal tag names in the notes
  (now read `raw`/`endraw`); all 10 chapters validate Liquid-clean.
- Fix two PRE-EXISTING unguarded `${{ }}` pages that render `$` on the live site
  (cicd-automation.md, agentic-codex orchestration doc).
- Add scripts/validation/check_liquid_raw.py + `make liquid-check` + a fast
